name: Other armed conflicts
summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea keep forces massed on their border after reported strikes near Badme; interstate war not confirmed
state: Reuters reported on 18 Nov that Ethiopia and Eritrea had massed substantial forces along their border, and residents near Badme reported drone and artillery strikes overnight into 19 Nov that neither military confirmed (Addis Standard via allAfrica). Eritrea condemned territorial remarks by Ethiopia's army chief in a statement on 18 Nov. Critical Threats tracked reported exchanges around Badme in mid-November. Searches on 27 Nov found no confirmed direct fighting, so the Alert is unconfirmed and Watch holds.
for_you: The FCDO advises against travel to parts of Ethiopia, including areas near the Eritrean border. A direct war would add to displacement in Tigray and the wider Horn of Africa and could affect Red Sea security.
rubric_hit: Watch: significant deterioration — Ethiopia–Eritrea troop build-up with reported Badme strikes 18–19 Nov; war unconfirmed
